trigger_condition: A 129th nondeleted serial device is created or moved onto one port.
guard_snippet: await enforce_serial_port_capacity(session, target_port, maximum=128, include_disabled=True, lock_port=True)
potential_consequence: All registry refreshes fail; subsequent disables/deletions remain unapplied, and gateway restarts fail.

trigger_condition: Audit preparation creates a missing mutex under the protected C:\Ruisheng\audit directory.
potential_consequence: Preparation reports success, but maintenance and upgrade reject the mutex's inherited, unprotected ACL.

trigger_condition: Serial configuration changes while apply_alarm_reading awaits database access.
guard_snippet: SELECT ... WHERE d.update_flag = :expected_version AND d.is_enabled AND d.deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE OF d
potential_consequence: A pre-change value can trigger or clear alarms using post-change thresholds, points, or scaling.

trigger_condition: Selecting zero_origin_38 with a template containing FC4 or out-of-range points.
